_comment: Cross-language TWIN fixture (debt #284). The single arbiter read by BOTH tests/unit/domain/services/test_twin_packing_class_key.py and desktop/src/renderer/src/utils/geotechHierarchicalFill/packingClassKey.twin.test.ts. It pins the geotech packing-class identity rule shared by packing_class_key.py (packing_class_key_of) and packingClassOf.ts (buildPackingClassOf): a formation row with BOTH a NAD class and a soil code collapses to 'SOIL|CLASS'; a row missing either half keeps ITS OWN row identity (two unknowns are not known to be the same density), so it never welds across rows. The effective key is 'SOIL|CLASS' when both are known and the formation id itself otherwise. The Python callable folds the 'unknown -> id' fallback in; the TS builder returns a Map with no entry for the unknown case and the call site applies '?? id' (PartitionFillOverlay.tsx). The contract compares the EFFECTIVE key: python key_of(id) vs (tsMap.get(id) ?? id). Change a value here and BOTH suites go red.

cases.name: fully_known_sand_collapses_to_soil_and_class
cases.description: A row with both a NAD class and a soil code keys to 'SOIL|CLASS'.

cases.name: two_rows_of_the_same_class_and_soil_weld_to_one_key
cases.description: Two NAD-6 sands under different row ids collapse to the same key: one mass, one body (owner 2026-08-21).

cases.name: same_soil_different_class_stays_distinct
cases.description: Two clays that differ only in NAD class keep distinct keys.

cases.name: missing_nad_class_keeps_row_identity
cases.description: A skeleton band over unread ground (no NAD class) never welds; it keeps its own row id.

cases.name: missing_soil_code_keeps_row_identity
cases.description: A row with a class but no soil code keeps its own row id; folding a missing soil to a placeholder would silently weld unrelated rows.

cases.name: both_halves_missing_keeps_row_identity
cases.description: A row missing both halves keeps its own row id.

cases.name: id_absent_from_the_rows_maps_to_itself
cases.description: An id not present among the rows (a litho-model region blind-mapped through the key) resolves to itself.
